items.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025
items.q: Interviewer introduces himself as Monk Rowe; Interviewee responds to the interviewer, not Monk Rowe as a subject of relationship.

ctx.x: Howard was interviewed via Zoom on November 11, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and I’m very pleased to start this interview today with Howard Levy. Welcome, sir, and congratulations on your career.
